channel.title: Hypewire
channel.description: What people are talking about in AI, entertainment, gaming and tech, refreshed daily.

item.title: Sunrise on the Reaping opens to $120 million in the US and $225 million worldwide
item.description: The Hunger Games prequel topped the weekend with a $120 million North American opening and $105 million overseas, Flickering Myth reports.

item.title: GTA VI makes $3.79 billion on day one, Rockstar says
item.description: Rockstar says Grand Theft Auto VI took $3.79 billion in first-day worldwide retail sales, and 32.5 million copies were pre-sold.

item.title: Anthropic mathematician says Claude helped him prove the Riemann Hypothesis
item.description: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge says he proved the Riemann Hypothesis with help from Claude, Bloomberg reports.

item.title: Nvidia opens a CEO search as its board rules out Jensen Huang's return
item.description: Nvidia's board has hired Heidrick & Struggles to find a new CEO and says it does not plan to reinstate Huang, after shares fell 14% on Friday.

item.title: Questions grow over Anthropic's IPO as its shares keep sliding
item.description: The FT asks whether Anthropic and its bankers got the IPO wrong, after weak trading and a quick use of the option to sell extra shares.

item.title: AI-led sell-off deepens, dragging Bitcoin to a 20-week low near $60,000
item.description: After the Nasdaq's 5.28% fall on November 20, the tech sell-off has spread, with Bitcoin dropping to about $60,000, TechJuice reports.

item.title: Amazon is said to be close to buying video AI startup Decart for $7.5 billion
item.description: The FT reports Amazon is in advanced talks to buy Israeli video-model startup Decart for about $7.5 billion, with a deal possible this week.

item.title: South Korea's education minister resigns over AI cheating in university exams
item.description: South Korea's education minister has resigned after a scandal over AI-assisted cheating in university entrance exams, The Guardian reports.

item.title: Apple is said to plan an iPhone 18, iPhone 18e and new Macs for February or March
item.description: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports Apple plans an iPhone 18e, iPhone 18, entry iPad, MacBook Neo and MacBook Air for around February or March.

item.title: Google shares are down 18% since it reported a sharp slowdown in search ads
item.description: The Information reports Google shares have fallen 18% since the company disclosed a sharp slowdown in search-ad growth, partly linked to AI.

item.title: GTA VI fans are reportedly review-bombing the Ocarina of Time remake
item.description: Nintendo Life reports the Ocarina of Time remake's positive user score has come under fire, reportedly from GTA VI fans.

item.title: Cleverbridge says hackers copied card numbers and CVVs from its platform
item.description: E-commerce platform Cleverbridge, whose clients include Red Hat and Sony, says a third party copied stored payment card data, including CVVs.

item.title: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 models get to the point but admit less doubt, test finds
item.description: The Decoder reports OpenAI's new GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol give shorter, more direct answers but score lower than Claude on transparency.

item.title: TfL says attackers accessed data of 265,000 Oyster photocard holders
item.description: Transport for London says about 265,000 Oyster photocard accounts, including children's Zip cards and 60+ cards, had personal details exposed.

item.title: Apple's reported Mac AI agent may not arrive until late 2027
item.description: Apple is said to be building an agent that controls apps, browses and codes, but Digital Trends reports it may not arrive until the end of 2027.

item.title: Bipartisan US governors ask Washington to set rules for the most powerful AI
item.description: A bipartisan group of US governors wants federal rules for the most powerful AI systems, while keeping states' power to protect people.

item.title: Documentary You Can See Everything passes $100 million worldwide
item.description: The documentary has crossed $100 million worldwide on a reported $7 million budget, adding $9 million as its global rollout began.

item.title: Signal blocks mobile screenshots of chats to keep out AI assistants
item.description: Signal is restricting screenshots on mobile and blocking assistants such as Siri and Gemini from capturing chats, calling AI agents a threat to privacy.

item.title: OpenRouter drops three AI providers after researchers find stolen keys
item.description: OpenRouter removed three inference providers and 125 endpoints from its zero-data-retention list after Dragos found compromised providers.

item.title: Blade Runner 2099 arrives on Prime Video with all eight episodes on November 25
item.description: The Blade Runner series lands on Prime Video on November 25 as an eight-episode binge release, NewsBeep's weekly TV schedule lists.

item.title: Toby Fox says Deltarune Chapter 6 is now a structurally complete draft
item.description: In his autumn newsletter, Toby Fox says Deltarune Chapter 6 is progressing well as a structurally complete draft, with an update on Chapter 7 too.

item.title: Microsoft is retiring its To Do app and pointing users to Planner
item.description: Microsoft plans to retire its To Do apps next year, with Planner as the replacement, which needs a Microsoft 365 business or education licence.

item.title: Bessent says US chip limits on China are enough, after House licence report
item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says current limits on Nvidia chips to China are sufficient, after a House report on approved sales.

item.title: I Play Rocky takes second with $9.3 million in its wide expansion
item.description: Peter Farrelly's Stallone biopic expanded from limited release to earn $9.3 million and finish second, Flickering Myth reports.

item.title: Persona 6 has no date, but a website update fuels Game Awards trailer talk
item.description: Atlus says Persona 6 has no release date yet, while an update to its web domain has fans expecting a trailer at The Game Awards on December 10.

item.title: Extortion group claims leak of Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan customer data
item.description: A group called n0n claims it stole data tied to Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan, and the banks say marketing data at vendors was exposed.

item.title: Microsoft says an Entra Connect Health flaw was used to take tenant data
item.description: Microsoft has disclosed that attackers exploited a flaw in its Entra Connect Health API to reach tenant metadata, including admin emails, reports say.

item.title: Lenders back SpaceX's $43 billion GPU deal but worry the chips could go to orbit
item.description: Tom's Hardware reports lenders funding a $43 billion Nvidia GPU lease for SpaceX worry the hardware could be hard to reclaim if sent to space.

item.title: Macy's 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade airs on NBC this Thursday
item.description: NBC will air the 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade on November 26 at 8:30 a.m., leading the holiday's TV schedule.

item.title: Grand Theft Auto VI's soundtrack album is out, with vinyl on the way
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6: The Album is now available to stream and buy, and a vinyl edition has been announced, DayOne reports.

item.title: Hackers used AI agents to find a zero-day in a medical imaging server, Amazon says
item.description: Amazon says suspected China-linked hackers used autonomous AI agents to find an unknown flaw in MONAI Label and take over a university server.

item.title: The Rings of Power season 3 finale lands on Prime Video on November 24
item.description: Amazon's Lord of the Rings series ends its third season on Tuesday, a date Forbes lists as moved up.

item.title: Ebenezer drops 60% in its second weekend but passes $78 million worldwide
item.description: Johnny Depp's Christmas film made $7.7 million, down 60% from its opening, and has earned $78 million worldwide on a $38 million budget.

item.title: Twitch calls GTA VI its largest game launch ever
item.description: Twitch says GTA VI was its biggest game launch, with 3.3 million viewers at once, Bloomberg reports. StreamCharts counted nearly 8 million in all.

item.title: Nintendo's winter catalogue gives a first glimpse of Pokemon Winds and Waves
item.description: Nintendo's Japanese Winter Catalogue includes a short description of Pokemon Winds and Waves, promising islands and a vast ocean to explore.

item.title: Yellowjackets begins its final season on Paramount+
item.description: The fourth and final 10-episode season of Yellowjackets premiered on November 20, with the finale set for January 22, 2027, Forbes reports.

item.title: Peacock releases DIG, a 10-episode series led by Amy Poehler
item.description: All ten episodes of DIG, led by Amy Poehler, arrive on Peacock on November 23, NewsBeep's weekly schedule lists.

item.title: The Wolf Among Us Remastered is set for November 29 on the original Switch
item.description: Telltale's remaster of The Wolf Among Us has an eShop date of November 29 on the original Switch, after an earlier delay.

item.title: Percy Jackson and the Olympians season 3 premieres on Disney+
item.description: The third season of the Percy Jackson series arrived on Disney+ and Hulu on November 20, leading the weekend's streaming picks.

item.title: Nintendo says the Zelda edition Switch 2 will be back in US stores soon
item.description: Nintendo's Latin America VP says the Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2 should return to US stock soon, Nintendo Life reports.

item.title: Capcom reveals Boat Man, the sixth Robot Master in Mega Man: Dual Override
item.description: Capcom has revealed Boat Man as the sixth Robot Master of Mega Man: Dual Override, due in 2027 on Switch and Switch 2.

item.title: BADBOX botnet returns on cheap Android TV boxes with 40 billion ad requests a day
item.description: The BADBOX malware found on generic Android TV boxes is back running ad fraud at a record 40 billion ad requests a day, BleepingComputer reports.

item.title: PBS airs Paul Simon's first full live performance of Seven Psalms
item.description: Paul Simon: The Quiet Celebration Concert airs on PBS on Thanksgiving night, billed as the first live performance of the complete Seven Psalms.

item.title: Ubisoft is down 1,100 staff in six months as it launches an AI subsidiary
item.description: After cutting 166 more jobs in Montreal and Quebec City, Ubisoft is down about 1,100 staff in six months and has set up an AI unit called Motherbrain.
